recipes.oracle_text: Counter target spell with mana value X. (For example, if that spell's mana cost is {3}{U}{U}, X is 5.)

recipe_coverage: Complete source Oracle identity/text and independent witnesses are pinned. Both controllers cast actual parent and response spells through stack1/stack2 and full drain, checking printed payment, denied payment/legality, typed targets, own/opposing parents, exact zones and libraries, and populated snapshot replay. Optional controller draw acceptance/decline, draw-before-discard with legal-card hand/grave conservation, discard after tax payment, token identity/characteristics/real sacrifice-for-mana, optional selected/unselected creature counters and persistence through cleanup are checked where printed. Zero-mana-value and alternative/variable-mana-value parents. Countered response source, lost targets, replacement/prevention, simultaneous responses and multiplayer remain separate gaps.
